title: Backflow preventer replacement cost is an installation-and-closeout scope
description: Compare replacement quotes by approved assembly, size, access, repiping, drainage, permits, certified test, and accepted report—not by body price alone.
prompt: What makes replacement more than a swap?
answer: Replacement cost changes when the assembly type, pipe layout, access, drainage, permit, test, or utility approval changes. A correct quote describes the finished compliant installation.
urgency: Do not choose a replacement assembly from price or pipe size alone. The governing utility and required hazard protection control the acceptable path.
diagramAlt: Replacement scope showing approved assembly, piping, access, drainage, test, and report closeout
identifiers: Like-for-like replacement may still require different fittings, clearance, drainage, or test work.
An RPZ can create relief-discharge requirements that must be scoped before installation.
A replacement is not complete until any required test and report are accepted.

choices.label: Replacing a damaged assembly
choices.detail: Document the body, size, layout, and required post-install test before comparing quotes.

choices.label: Comparing repair and replacement
choices.detail: Use the whole closeout cost rather than only the next repair bill.

choices.label: The local rule is unknown
choices.detail: Confirm the accepted assembly with the governing utility first.

steps.title: Confirm the accepted assembly
steps.body: Use the hazard, system use, and governing utility rule before choosing a replacement body.

steps.title: Measure the site
steps.body: Document size, direction, access, drainage, freeze exposure, clearances, and shutdown constraints.

steps.title: Compare final scope
steps.body: Separate assembly, fittings, labor, drainage, permit, test, report filing, and restoration in writing.

safeChecks: Photograph the current assembly and pipe layout.
Ask whether the replacement is on the applicable approved-device path.
Ask whether the initial test and filing are included.
notThisDevice: A generic retail backflow body may not satisfy the governing utility rule.
A repair kit does not replace a damaged or obsolete body.
A sewer backwater valve cost is a separate drainage project.
evidenceNote: This planner prevents false price comparisons by separating equipment from physical installation and compliance closeout.
